events.summary: First cut drafted from Wikipedia, Palmpedia, Useful Tropical Plants/IUCN, and nursery sources. Confident on range, morphology, IUCN status, cultural use, and general Sabal genus ecology. Less certain on precise Florida cultivation history and bloom/fruiting months specific to S. domingensis (extrapolated from genus).

events.feedback:

Because you want this to be a competitive, visitor-friendly profile that outshines traditional dry signage, here is a critique of the draft with a few actionable changes to elevate it before publication.
